definitions.local_open_or_public_reference: Resource is freely redistributable; may be referenced by URL or name in public reports. Rows still must not be embedded.
definitions.local_license_gated_reference: Resource exists locally under a publisher license; presence may be referenced by canonical folder name only. Rows, license text, and license-acknowledgement contents must never appear in public reports or any committed file.
definitions.local_private_acknowledgement_only: Operator-supplied private license acknowledgement file. Presence may be checked; contents must never be read or committed.
definitions.prohibited_for_commit: Must never be added to git, even when present locally. Enforced by .gitignore.
definitions.runtime_private_store_only: Resource may be loaded into a private local DB/index for runtime lookup; the DB and index themselves are prohibited_for_commit.
definitions.aggregate_public_report_only: May appear in public reports only as aggregate counts (e.g. 'rows_imported: N'), never as row content.

entries.resource: MedAI MKB-style internal coding interfaces (already in repo)
B07 terminology mapping interface (already shipped, default-off)

private_store_access_rules: No public-report row dumps; only aggregate counts.
No license text or license acknowledgement contents ever written to public reports.
No private paths printed in public reports; use canonical folder names only.
No external API calls to remote terminology services.

prohibited_outputs: Raw terminology rows (LOINC/RxNorm/SNOMED/UMLS rows) in any committed file.
License acknowledgement contents in any committed file.
Private filesystem paths in public reports.
PHI or source-document text in any committed file.
Secrets / keys / tokens in any committed file.
Clinical interpretation (diagnosis, treatment, DDI, dosing) generated by terminology lookup.
Auto-acceptance of any record based on terminology match.
DDI status changes driven by terminology coding.
Hypothesis promotion (e.g. moving from review to accepted) driven by terminology coding.
public_report_rules: Anonymous identifiers (e.g. record_001) for any per-record reference.
Use short SHAs (max ~7 chars) for any commit reference.
No `.json` filename literals containing words like 'report' (privacy scanner trigger); use 'JSON report' phrasing or backtick-close before the extension.

future_integration_architecture.1_terminology_source_registry: A single read-only registry that enumerates canonical sources by name and license class. Already partly defined by terminology_sources_preflight.canonical_sources.
future_integration_architecture.2_license_class_gating_layer: Before any lookup call, the layer must verify license class and refuse to operate on a source whose `requires_manual_license_verification_before_implementation` flag is true and has not been explicitly cleared.
future_integration_architecture.3_private_local_terminology_store_bounda: A local SQLite or sqlcipher index whose path is .gitignored. Read-only at runtime. No public exposure of row content.
future_integration_architecture.4_no_public_row_output_rule: Every emitted public report must pass an aggregate-only check before write.
future_integration_architecture.5_aggregate_only_reporting_rule: Public reports may include counts, distribution buckets, and controlled-vocabulary status fields only.
future_integration_architecture.6_review_bound_hypothesis_annotation_rul: Any coding annotation produced is review_required=true and auto_accept_allowed=false, mirroring the DIAG-17/18 metadata pattern.
future_integration_architecture.7_refusal_for_unsupported_clinical_infer: The terminology layer must explicitly refuse to: parse lab values, parse medication doses, change DDI status, infer diagnosis, infer treatment, or expand abbreviations. The TERM block must publish explicit `clinical_*_performed=false` flags in every emitted plan.
future_integration_architecture.8_local_only_posture: MEDAI_LOCAL_ONLY=1 and MEDAI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_API=0 must remain shipped defaults. No external terminology API enabled by default.
future_integration_architecture.9_no_external_api_default: External terminology APIs (UMLS REST, NLM web services, SNOMED Cloud) must remain disabled unless an explicitly approved, separately-scoped block enables them with their own SPEC.
future_integration_architecture.10_operator_visible_wording_boundaries: All operator-visible terminology output must be limited to controlled vocabulary tokens (e.g. 'terminology_match_hypothesis') and a fixed disclaimer ('Review metadata only. Not a final code. Not clinical interpretation.').
future_integration_architecture.11_validation_and_rollback_plan: Every new block in this track must ship a focused pytest module that asserts default-off behavior, aggregate-only output, and refusal of clinical inference. Rollback path: unset the controlling feature flag; remove the runtime adapter import.

rollback_or_stop_conditions: Privacy check on any public report fails → stop, redact, must not commit.
Licensed terminology row appears in any committed file → revert that commit, audit history.
License acknowledgement contents appear in any public file → revert, audit history.
Any focused test from required_tests_for_next_block fails → stop, fix, re-run before merge.
Feature flag turns on by default in any deployment → stop, fix default-off invariant, re-run UAT.
PARK-20..23 or FREEZE tags appear moved → stop, restore from local reflog or co-author audit.
Operator UAT records a regression in Run & Review caused by terminology lookup → disable the feature flag, file a new diagnostic block.
External terminology API gets enabled accidentally → stop, disable, audit env var configuration.
